clauses.clause_text: It shields the final concrete lining from direct contact with groundwater.
literal_spans: yer altı sularının tünel içerisine sızmasının önlenmesi
clauses.reason: The source states the purpose as preventing groundwater seepage into the tunnel. 'Shields the lining from direct contact' is a stronger, differently-scoped statement; only the water-exclusion part maps.

clauses.clause_text: It protects the final lining from potentially harmful chemical substances in the water.
literal_spans: nihai beton kaplamanın zararlı kimyasal madde etkilerine karşı korunması
clauses.reason: Direct equivalent: protection of the final concrete lining against harmful chemical effects. No qualifier, number or modality added.

clauses.clause_text: It protects the final lining from hydrostatic pressure.
clauses.reason: The source attributes hydrostatic-pressure prevention to the protective felt/drainage layer (keçe tabakası), not to the membrane. Re-attributing it to the membrane would be a new fact.
